'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Matt Thomas LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thomas]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: The Hollywood Kid goes to the ghetto. Transcription note: same name and username as p107 (small-world rule: Matt Thomas, not Matt Thornton); heavy shorthand

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' Bren Derlin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
